rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the ordinary white colour.

example.jyutping: gin6 saam1 hai6 baak6 sik1 ge3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the color itself.

example.english: The room uses white as its main color, so it is very bright.
example.traditional: 間房用白色做主色，好光猛。
example.jyutping: gaan1 fong2 jung6 baak6 sik1 zou6 zyu2 sik1 hou2 gwong1 maang5

rows.note: Use this for the albumen inside an egg, not for the color white.

example.english: The white of this egg is not cooked yet.
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 daan2 ge3 daan6 baak6 zung6 mei6 suk6

rows.note: Use this for something that is relatively light or pale in colour rather than pure white.

example.english: I want to buy the pale white trousers.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 cin2 sik1 go2 tiu4 fu3

rows.note: Use this when referring to a white person of European descent.

example.english: That white person is asking for directions.
example.jyutping: go2 go3 baak6 jan4 hai2 dou6 man6 lou6

rows.note: Use this for a person's unhealthy or frightened pallor.

example.english: He went white when he heard the news.
example.traditional: 佢一聽到個消息就面青。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou2 go3 siu1 sik1 zau6 min6 cing1

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when someone's hair has turned mostly or completely grey.

example.english: He isn't even fifty, but his hair has already gone completely white.
example.traditional: 佢都未夠五十歲，已經白晒頭喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dou1 mei6 gau3 ng5 sap6 seoi3 ji5 ging1 baak6 saai3 tau4 laa3
